title: Lael NDE 6939/899
content:
6939: I experienced an eclamptic [Editor’s note: A form of toxemia of pregnancy.] convulsion the day after I gave birth. It was so severe that my heart stopped. At first, all I experienced was cold, and then my soul floated up out of my body. When I reached the level of the ceiling in my room, I turned around and saw my dead body on the bed. I felt a moment of regret, such as one might feel seeing a beautiful purebred dog dead on the side of the highway. It was a good body and it had served me well, but that part of my existence was over with and I was ready to move on. I did see the medical personnel who were scrambling to resuscitate me and I wished I could tell them not to bother. I turned around, looked up at the ceiling, and floated up into the plenum and through the roof of the building. Once I was outside, I had the feeling that it was night. A shaft of brilliant white light, similar to looking into an aircraft searchlight, pierced the dark sky above me. By contrast, the dark around me was so deep it was palpable. I ‘fell’ upward through that light, but when I reached a threshold, a point of no return, I was stopped. I kept looking into the light. Within it were all the love, beauty, acceptance, and bliss imaginable. How can one describe perfection? I knew God was behind that light and I wanted more than anything to join the beings that I knew were with Him. However, a voice said, ‘Go back. It isn't time.’ The light winked out and I woke up in my body, sick, hurting, and bitterly disappointed. The experience did leave me changed. I will never fear death again. I only wish I could tell everyone that at the end, God handles us gently. There will be only joy when we cross that barrier. The kicker was that the voice that told me to go back. I could never forget the timbre, pace, pitch, and pronunciation I heard. It was the voice my son (a day old at the time of the incident) has now: as a grown man.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported 'cold' initially; 'soul floated up out of my body'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A shaft of brilliant white light in a dark sky; she 'fell' upward through that light.

arrival.other_being_detail: She believed 'God was behind that light' and that there were 'beings' with Him, but no beings were visually described.

environment.environment_other_detail: Deep palpable darkness; felt it was night; brilliant white light like an aircraft searchlight.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Eclamptic convulsion (toxemia of pregnancy) the day after giving birth; heart stopped.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard a voice saying, 'Go back. It isn't time.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (saw body/medical staff) → moved outside into darkness/night → encountered brilliant light → reached threshold/point of no return → told to go back → returned to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The voice telling her to return matched the voice her newborn son would have as an adult (timbre, pace, pitch, pronunciation).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Go back. It isn't time.”; “God handles us gently. There will be only joy when we cross that barrier.”
